discovery_card.text: Tuition and fee refund percentages when a student drops or withdraws from a course at Delaware State University. Covers how much money is refunded depending on how long after the start of instruction the withdrawal happens, for both the fall/spring semesters and the accelerated, summer, and winter sessions. Answers questions about getting money back for a dropped class, refund deadlines, and financial responsibility for withdrawn courses.
discovery_card.note: The tool computes the student's specific outcome from their withdrawal date. The table is never handed to the student to interpret.

payload.title: Refund Schedule for Course Withdrawals - Fall/Spring Semesters

input_spec.name: days_since_first_instruction
input_spec.description: Calendar days from the first day of instruction to the withdrawal date. The source does not state whether the first day counts as day 0 or day 1 - see data_quality_flags.

input_spec.name: on_or_before_last_day_to_add
input_spec.description: Whether the withdrawal falls on or before the term's Last Day to Add Classes.

rules.label: Pre-registration to Last Day to Add Classes
rules.notes: For Fall 2026 the Last Day to Add is September 3, which is 9 calendar days after the August 25 first day of instruction. This row therefore overlaps the 80% and 60% rows below.

rules.label: Nine Calendar Days or less
rules.notes: Read as days 7-9 given the preceding row, but the source does not say so.
